sentences.sentence_text: Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to make governed agentic AI a repeatable enterprise business, aligning control-plane architecture, an IP-led commercial engine, and partner-channel enablement so regulated clients could move from tailored engagements toward productized services and durable platform adoption.

material_claims.claim_text: Owned governed agentic AI platform architecture as the foundation for repeatable enterprise deployment.
Connected platform productization and IP-led commercialization with enterprise adoption and reusable services.
Integrated partner-supported adoption into the commercial operating model for enterprise AI.
